Prakash 01.prakash.08@gmail.com | +91-9816648872 | https://www.linkedin.com/in/prakashiimb/

9 years of experience as a cross-functional team leader with extensive experience driving strategic Data Science and Artificial Intelligence roadmaps and leading the end-to-end design, development, and deployment of sophisticated machine learning solutions. Proven ability to mentor and guide cross-functional teams of data scientists and engineers to deliver significant business impact and operational efficiency. Skilled in product strategy, business consulting, Generative AI, advanced RAG architectures, establishing robust MLOps frameworks and ensuring stringent data governance across complex cloud environments. Adept at translating technical insights into strategic recommendations.

Key Skills • Tech Skills: Python, AWS Bedrock, GCP MLOps, RAG, LLM Chatbots, NLP, Agile Scrum, Figma, Jira, PowerBI, SDLC, OpenAI, Gemini • Certifications: Data Scientist III (Workera), Data Analytics (Google), Machine Learning and Python (Kaggle) • Achievements: 13th rank in Regional Mathematics Olympiad, 99.14 percentile in AIEEE, 99.43 percentile in GATE, 730/800 in GMAT

Robotics and Computer Vision

Professional Experience Senior AI Project Manager (Gnani.AI) • Led and mentored a 7-person cross-functional ML development team, overseeing the deployment of Multimodal Agentic AI solutions

9 Years September 2025 – November 2025

utilizing customized SLMs and RAG architectures for Telephony use cases for 20+ enterprises. This effort ensured technical alignment with client SLAs, resulting in a 20% Reduction in Average Handle Time (AHT) and 50% Shorter Hold Times through agent co-piloting.

Developed and executed the Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy for the Speech Analytics product line, leveraging Inya Insights for automated quality assurance and call analytics across omnichannel environments. This provided clear success metrics and achieved a 60% Reduction in QA OpEx for enterprise clients, effectively communicating business value to executives.

Data and AI Consultant (Accenture Strategy and Consulting) • Zero to One (0-1) : Led the development of a Gen-AI based RAG tool helping financial institutions in SFDR reporting compliance in the EU.

June 2023 – September 2025

Leveraged existing cloud infra infrastructure to incorporate the RAG tool with AWS Bedrock, reducing cost by 15%. – Optimized RAG chunking to work with the client use-case, improving vector search and retrieval results by 8%. – Developed the Product Strategy, Roadmap, Testing Plan, Issue Resolution SOPs and Risk assessment report. – Managed a team of engineers , developed SOPs to write backend APIs using LLMs to reduce development time by 25%.

Led Generative AI-based RAG solution for the EU's Environmental and Social Due Diligence (ESDD) for Financial Institutions Implemented the workflow using n8n, integrating the RAG tool with legal databases to reduce manual review by 20 hours per week.

– Leveraged Loveable to rapidly build the RAG tool's front-end, cutting the UI development cycle by 50%. – Optimized RAG vector store and chunking for complex regulations, boosting retrieval accuracy from 75% to 92%. – Engineered a dynamic n8n webhook pipeline for document ingestion, ensuring 100% data currency with ESDD regulatory updates.

Developed a Windfarm Management Suite (WMS) leveraging TensorFlow deep learning models, improving O&M efficiency by 22%. – Engineered component-wise predictive maintenance (PdM) models, forecasting failures and extending lifespan by 6 months. – Created a live dashboard, providing real-time visualization and alerts, leading to a 40% reduction in unplanned downtime. – Deployed deep learning models via a fully operational MLOps framework, enabling $1M+ in annual savings by improving predictions. • Designed the data strategy for a major pharma giant, establishing a Single Source of Truth (SSOT) Data Lake and leading data migration with 100% data integrity testing using an automated DIFW framework, successfully ingesting 1TB of data weekly with zero downtime.

Developed the ESG360 NLP Pipeline, utilizing Generative AI for retrieval from unstructured PDFs and transformation into structured data. Implemented a Unified Data Model for ESG disclosures, ensuring automated ETL alignment with 12 global reporting regulations.

– Engineered advanced NLP and GenAI retrieval pipelines to automate regulatory gap assessment and overlap identification, accelerating compliance reviews. Enhanced multi-level aggregation processes and scoring methodology (e.g., weighted techniques), reducing metric discrepancies by 25% and improving KPI impact accuracy by 35%.

Innovated an analytical methodology to automate multi-vendor data aggregation, boosting efficiency by 60% across sustainability metrics. • Developed a novel, materiality-driven ESG benchmarking methodology for the semiconductor industry, utilizing materiality-driven scoring.

Deputy Manager (NHPC Limited) • Managed regulatory compliances for INR 360 Crore Hydro-power Renovation and Modernisation(R&M) project.

September 2015 – March 2022

o Liaised with 5 departments and 13 contractors for early project commissioning, adding INR 1.85 Cr in revenue. o Spearheaded negotiations with government agencies & regulators, obtaining 6 critical approvals for R&M project.

Supervised ERP implementation for reporting automation resulting in standardisation & reduction of manual efforts by 80% o Trained ~80 engineers for transitioning from manual report to automated process using ERP system

Enhanced data acquisition process of energy meters, leading to a 95% speed improvement in data ingestion. • Drove a critical surveillance infrastructure project, delivered innovative optimization of existing resources, saving INR 20 Lakhs in costs. • Led digitalization project of the department to be the first in NHPC to process 100% workflow through e-Office • Drove digital procurement process adoption through Government-e-Marketplace portal to achieve 70% CAPEX o Co-ordinated supplier base onboarding onto GeM portal in procurement process resulting in TAT improvements
